summary: PLAT-103 shipped in one PR (#1): validateApp now throws if owner missing/empty; core-shell passes owner 'platform', billing 'payments' (from package.json team). Assumptions: shared-contracts is an in-repo lib inlined at build time (CONTRIBUTING), so no registry publish or dependency adoption needed; bumped its version to 2.0.0 as a breaking change anyway; single PR since inlining removes ordering constraint. Also set owner 'insights' on reports (not in ticket) since it calls validateApp and would otherwise throw. CI and CD green.
